# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: Prevent NPEs for possible null value returned from Evaluator.eval* methods
- Jira bug report description: I just encountered the following NPE:\n\n java.lang.NullPointerException\n at org.apache.commons.scxml2.semantics.SCXMLSemanticsImpl.filterTransitionsSet(SCXMLSemanticsImpl.java:415)\n at org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCXMLExecutor.triggerEvents(SCXMLExecutor.java:124)\n at org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCXMLExecutor.reset(SCXMLExecutor.java:256)\n at org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCXMLExecutor.go(SCXMLExecutor.java:349)\n\nThis turned out to be caused by an transition condition (evaluated through Jexl) resulting in, and thus also returning, a null value.\nA quick scan through the usages of Evaluator.eval* method shows several locations within SCXML where it always assumes an non-null value (Boolean or otherwise) to be returned. All possible sources for unexpected NPEs.\n\nI think that for at least the Evaluator#evalCond method, which is assumed to return a Boolean, either an error should be catched/returned or maybe even assume null == Boolean.FALSE.
- Seed changes and their Git diff hunks: [{"fqn": "org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.If.execute(org.apache.commons.scxml2.EventDispatcher,org.apache.commons.scxml2.ErrorReporter,org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCInstance,org.apache.commons.logging.Log,java.util.Collection)", "git_diff_hunk": "@@ -124 +125,15 @@ public class If extends Action {\n- execute = eval.evalCond(ctx, cond).booleanValue();\n+ Boolean rslt = Boolean.FALSE;\n+ try {\n+ rslt = eval.evalCond(ctx, cond);\n+ if (rslt == null) {\n+ if (appLog.isDebugEnabled()) {\n+ appLog.debug(\"Treating as false because the cond expression was evaluated as null: '\" + cond + \"'\");\n+ }\n+ rslt = Boolean.FALSE;\n+ }\n+ } catch (SCXMLExpressionException e) {\n+ rslt = Boolean.FALSE;\n+ errRep.onError(ErrorConstants.EXPRESSION_ERROR, \"Treating as false due to error: \" + e.getMessage(), this);\n+ // TODO: place the error 'error.execution' in the internal event queue. (section \"3.12.2 Errors\")\n+ }\n+ execute = rslt.booleanValue();"}]
- Initial static code change impact set: ["org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.If.execute", "org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.If.execute(org.apache.commons.scxml2.EventDispatcher,org.apache.commons.scxml2.ErrorReporter,org.apache.commons.scxml2.SCInstance,org.apache.commons.scxml2.model.Log,java.util.Collection)"]

# Output Format
Return exactly one valid single-line JSON array of strings.
Each string must be the fully qualified name of an impacted code entity.
Do not include any additional text, formatting, or meta-information.
Do not include seed changes in the output.

Example output (four impacted code entities):
["com.example.Foo.someMethod(java.lang.String, int)", "com.example.bar.attribute1", "com.example.bar.Class.NestedClass", "com.example.bar.Class.Class()"]

Example output (two impacted code entities):
["com.example.package.ParentClass.ChildClass.field", "com.example.package.ParentClass.apply(long, com.example.package.ParentClass)"]

Example output (zero impacted code entities):
[]
